description_en: Suggests FAQs from the knowledge base based on a user query
description_zh: 根据用户query联想知识库中的FAQ
kebab_example: aliyun chatbot associate --instance-id chatbot-cn-mp90s2lrk00050 --utterance '公积金提取' --perspective FZJBY3raWr --session-id 7c3cec23cc8940bc9db4a318c8f4f0aa --recommend-num 8 --agent-key ac627989eb4f8a98ed05fd098bbae5_p_beebot_public --api-version 2022-04-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: Associate

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the robot
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The perspective code, which is used to call answers from different perspectives under the same knowledge title. When assembling request parameters, pass the parameter in the format Perspective={perspective code}. For example: &Perspective=["FZJBY3raWr"]. When using the SDK, use the parameters defined in the SDK. Currently, only one perspective answer can be called
parameters.help_zh: 视角编码，用于调用同一知识标题下不同视角的答案。在拼装请求参数时，需要以Perspective={视角编码}的格式传递参数。如：&Perspective=["FZJBY3raWr"]。使用SDK时以SDK中定义的参数为准。目前仅支持一个视角答案的调用
parameters.name: perspective

parameters.help_en: The session ID, which is used to identify a visitor's session and maintain context information. For a new visitor, you do not need to pass this field when calling the Chat operation for the first time. The robot starts a session and returns the SessionId of the session in the response of the Chat operation. For subsequent conversation turns of the visitor, pass the SessionId of the current session when calling the Chat operation so that the robot can continue the conversation based on the SessionId
parameters.help_zh: 会话ID，用于标识一个访问者的会话和保持上下文信息。对于一个新的访问者，首次调用Chat接口时无需传递此字段，机器人会开启一个会话，并在Chat接口的响应中返回该会话的SessionId。对于该访问者的后续轮次的会话，调用Chat接口时传递当前会话的SessionId，机器人即可基于SessionId继续该轮次会话
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en: The number of recommended questions, ranging from 1 to 10. This parameter takes effect only when recommendations are returned. The number of returned recommended questions is less than or equal to RecommendNum
parameters.help_zh: 推荐问题数量，1-10，当出推荐的时候才生效，返回小于等于RecommendNum的推荐问题
parameters.name: recommend_num

parameters.help_en: The business space key. If not specified, the default business space is accessed. Obtain the key value from the business management page of the primary account
parameters.help_zh: 业务空间key，不设置则访问默认业务空间，key值在主账号业务管理页面获取
parameters.name: agent_key

Title.description_en: The title of the associated question

MessageId.description_en: The ID of the response message in the current session

SessionId.description_en: The ID of the current session
